nary_nodes.label: Wildfire in Fontainebleau
evidence: The fire, which officials described as "very virulent" and of "exceptional scale," began late afternoon in the sprawling Fontainebleau forest about 40 miles south-east of the capital.

nary_nodes.label: Deployment of firefighting planes
